answer: One concrete mechanism: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The network ties the jetty to sunk effort, uses the delta as an corroborating signal, then requires a relic before any payout.
